text: Given a caller invokes autotask_search_contacts without includeUserDefinedFields (or with it explicitly false), When the search returns matched contacts, Then no item in the response contains a userDefinedFields key and the response is otherwise identical in shape to today's
tests: tests/contact-search-custom-fields.test.ts > does not include userDefinedFields or request it from Autotask by default

text: Given a contact has one or more Autotask custom fields set, When autotask_search_contacts is called with includeUserDefinedFields: true, Then that contact's item in the response includes a userDefinedFields array with that contact's actual name/value pairs
tests: tests/contact-search-custom-fields.test.ts > returns a matched contact's actual custom fields when includeUserDefinedFields is true

text: Given a contact has no custom fields set in Autotask, When autotask_search_contacts is called with includeUserDefinedFields: true, Then the call does not error and that contact's item does not contain fabricated userDefinedFields data (key absent or an empty array)
tests: tests/contact-search-custom-fields.test.ts > does not fabricate userDefinedFields for a contact with none set

text: Given includeUserDefinedFields: true, When autotask_search_contacts returns matched contacts, Then every field normally present in the response today (id, firstName, lastName, emailAddress, companyID, and the enhanced company name when resolvable) is still present and unchanged
tests: tests/contact-search-custom-fields.test.ts > still returns every normally-returned field when includeUserDefinedFields is true

text: Given includeUserDefinedFields: true, When the search matches zero contacts, Then the tool returns the existing empty-result shape (0 items, 'Found 0 contacts') without error
tests: tests/contact-search-custom-fields.test.ts > returns an empty result without error when nothing matches

text: Given a caller filters by companyID and passes includeUserDefinedFields: true, When autotask_search_contacts runs, Then only contacts belonging to that companyID are returned (with their custom fields) -- the new flag does not relax or bypass the existing company-scoping filter and cannot be used to retrieve another company's contacts or their custom fields
tests: tests/contact-search-custom-fields.test.ts > includeUserDefinedFields does not relax the existing companyID filter
